body:
**Original comment by Leopoldo Saggin (Bitbucket: [Leopoldo Saggin](https://bitbucket.org/Leopoldo Saggin), ).**

----------------------------------------

In Italian we say “Ni”. I mean I’m not so sure things were related. When these things happens - as they are unexpected - most of the time you cannot be sure you can report **exactly** the sequence of what happened. Besides even if you are sure of what you report, it is not true that “_**post hoc, propter hoc**_” ie: as something happens after something, then there is a dependance between these two things.  
What I can say is: I had a problem for saving an image that was in queue to be saved; I removed the reason for which this happened. When I chosed to abort the saving \(cancelation of the object from the queue\), the screen became black, ART process was however present in Task Manager and even if I killed it, I wasn’t able to restart ART.  had to reboot the PC \(I did not try to see if other applications could be opened and/or were working.  
The only doubt I have is that, when I tried to restart ART I waited for it for the time I normally know ART needs to restart, but I’m not sure that in this case I had to wait longer.  
I add: I did these things without having a selected profile. If I remember correctly the program applied a “custom” profile but I did not created any profile.

Regards,

Topoldo/Leopoldo
